0022600135.text: The Philadelphia 76ers (3-0, 1st in the Atlantic, 2nd in the East) are on the road for their fifth game of the season, looking to extend a three-game winning streak against the Indiana Pacers (1-1, 9th in the East). Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti, Dominick Barlow, Jabari Walker, Joel Embiid, Tacko Fall and VJ Edgecombe, while Indiana is without Ben Sheppard and Johnny Furphy. The teams have not met yet this season, but the 76ers won all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently 105-94 in Indianapolis on April 10, 2026.
